nodes.text: Another virus spreading in China, it’s HMPV. It has overtaken the regular flu and has folks hospitalized with severe respiratory problems. Why are we allowing Chinese citizens to continue to come here? Haven’t we learned from COVID? Write or call your reps and senators.
